title.description: Short human-readable title for the project charter.

problem_statement.description: Concise description of the problem this project aims to solve, minimum 20 characters.

in_scope.description: Items explicitly within the boundaries of this project, at least 3 required.

out_of_scope.description: Items explicitly excluded from this project, at least 3 required.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during project scoping that could affect delivery if invalidated.

risks.description: Known risks that could impact project success or timeline.

stakeholders.description: Array of stakeholder roles and their needs relevant to this project.

items.description: A single stakeholder entry identifying a role and what that role needs from the project.

needs.description: List of needs or expectations this stakeholder has for the project.

role_ref.description: Canonical reference to a role defined in the canonical registry.

user_segments.description: Array of distinct user segments the project serves, each with jobs-to-be-done analysis.

items.description: A user segment describing a target audience, their goals, pains, and gains.

segment_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this user segment.

description.description: Human-readable description of who this user segment represents.

jobs_to_be_done.description: List of jobs this user segment is trying to accomplish.

pains.description: Pain points this user segment currently experiences.

gains.description: Benefits this user segment expects to achieve from the project.

success_metrics.description: Quantifiable metrics used to measure project success, at least 2 required.

items.description: A single success metric with baseline, target, and measurement method.

metric_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this success metric.

baseline.description: Current baseline value before the project begins.

target.description: Target value this metric should reach after project delivery.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for this metric (e.g., 'ms', 'percent', 'count').

measurement_method.description: How this metric will be measured or observed in practice.

unit_ref.description: Canonical reference to the unit defined in the canonical registry.

links.description: Array of external links relevant to the charter (e.g., design docs, research).
